svg.title: Prefix Sum Inclusion-Exclusion and Difference Array Range Updates
svg.desc: Animated visualization of O(1) 2D prefix sum rectangle queries via inclusion-exclusion over matrix P, alongside O(1) difference array range updates D[L]+=v and D[R+1]-=v reconstructed in a single O(n) prefix sweep.
svg.text: Prefix Sums & Difference Arrays: O(1) Queries & O(1) Range Additions
2D Inclusion-Exclusion Rectangle Query P[r2+1][c2+1] - P[r1][c2+1] - P[r2+1][c1] + P[r1][c1] vs D[L]+=v, D[R+1]-=v

g.text: Covers (0,0)..(2,2), which includes unwanted row 0 and column 0.
Removes row 0 (1 + 2 + 1). Note cell (0,0) has been subtracted once.
Removes col 0 (1 + 4 + 1). Cell (0,0) was subtracted TWICE!
Restores the double-subtracted top-left corner M[0][0] = 1.
4 array lookups regardless of matrix size -> strictly O(1) query!

svg.text: Build: P[i+1] = P[i] + A[i] in O(n) space and O(n) preprocessing.
Edge case: P[0] = 0 avoids boundary branches when L = 0.
With Hash Map { 0: 1 }: counts Subarray Sum == K even with negatives!
2. Difference Array: D[L] += v, D[R+1] -= v
Difference Array D[0..5] (stores delta A[i] - A[i-1]):

g.text: Ready to apply k arbitrary interval updates in O(1) each.
Only 2 boundary indices modified! Cancels +5 past index 3.
Overlapping interval [2..4] recorded in O(1) without touching index 3.
Single O(n) prefix pass accumulates overlapping deltas cleanly.
k updates + 1 sweep = O(n + k) vs naive O(n x k) brute force.

svg.text: Prefix Sum (integral): O(n) build, O(1) range query (static array)
Difference Array (derivative): O(1) range update, O(n) offline sweep
Boundary guard: in Difference Array, always guard `if (R + 1 < n) D[R + 1] -= v` (or allocate size n + 1). Interleaved updates + queries require a Fenwick/Segment tree.
